acip: GONG GI RTAGS GSUM PA MA GRUB NA, BUM PA CHOS CAN, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING DNGOS PO YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PAR THAL, TZANDAN GYI KVA BA DE YANG DE YIN, SHUG PA'I KVA BA DE YANG DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: gong gi rtags gsum pa ma grub na, bum pa chos can, khyod ma yin zhing dngos po yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub par thal, tsandan gyi kva ba de yang de yin, shug pa'i kva ba de yang de yin pa'i phyir
english: Then I disagree with the third part of your original reason: it's not true that there do exist many examples of other things which are not coffee cups but which are still working things. Suppose you do disagree. Let's then consider the coffee cup. It is so the case that there exist many examples of other things which are not coffee cups but which are still working things, Because a coffee table made of sandalwood is one such example; and a coffee table made of juniper wood is another such example.
